source: Dou S H, et al. What is wrong with your code generated by large language models? An extensive study. Sci China Inf Sci 2026, 69(1): 112107. Checklist and critique prompt from https://github.com/LLMCodeGenerationStudy/LLMCodeGenerationStudy/blob/main/Prompt_design/README.md

primary_types.name: Ambiguous problem description
primary_types.not_assigned_reason: Requires human judgement of the task text; no execution signal identifies it.

categories.name: Incomplete syntax structure
categories.repair_hint: The program is not syntactically complete (unclosed bracket, parenthesis or string, missing colon, or no code at all). Close every open structure and output the complete program as valid Python.

categories.name: Incorrect indentation
categories.repair_hint: Indentation is inconsistent with the block structure. Re-indent each block (def/if/for/while/with/try) with 4 spaces, do not mix tabs and spaces, and keep the logic unchanged.

categories.name: Library import error
categories.repair_hint: A module is missing, misspelled, used without being imported, or imported in an invalid place. Add the required standard-library imports at module top level and remove imports of modules that do not exist.

categories.name: API misuse
categories.repair_hint: An operation or method is used on a value of the wrong type, or an API that does not exist is called. Check the actual type of each value and use the correct standard-library API for it.

categories.name: Definition missing
categories.repair_hint: A variable, function, or the required entry point is referenced but never defined, misspelled, or used before assignment. Define it with the expected name and signature before it is used.

categories.name: Incorrect boundary condition check
categories.repair_hint: Execution crashed on an edge case (out-of-range index, missing key, invalid value, division by zero, overflow). Add explicit checks for empty inputs, zero, and index or key bounds before access.

categories.name: Incorrect argument
categories.repair_hint: A function is called with the wrong number of arguments or with wrong keyword arguments. Make each call match the signature of the function it calls, and keep the required entry-point signature.

categories.name: Minors
categories.repair_hint: Execution did not finish normally (time limit exceeded, unbounded recursion, or an exception the program defines and raises itself). Add base cases and loop exit conditions and remove unnecessary raises.

categories.name: Misunderstanding and logic error
categories.repair_hint: The program runs but returns wrong values. Re-read the problem requirements, compare the actual and expected values in the failing assertions, and correct the algorithm.

categories.name: Hallucination
categories.not_assigned_reason: Distinguishing hallucinated logic from a logic error needs semantic review of the code against the task; execution evidence alone cannot tell them apart.
categories.repair_hint: The code solves a different problem or contains logic unrelated to the task. Rewrite the solution strictly from the problem statement.

categories.name: Input/output format error
categories.repair_hint: The computed values are right but the output format is wrong (type, container, ordering, or numeric precision). Return exactly the type, structure, order, and precision the problem asks for.

categories.name: Minors
categories.not_assigned_reason: Minor functional deviations are not separable from logic errors using execution signals; assigning them needs human review.
categories.repair_hint: A small detail causes isolated failures (for example an off-by-one bound or a wrong initial value). Check comparison operators and initial values against the failing cases.

unmapped.name: Unmapped correctness finding
unmapped.repair_hint: The failure did not match any taxonomy rule. Read the error report and fix its cause.

checklist: 1.1 Bugs due to incorrect syntax structure.
1.2 LLMs only output explanation without code.
2.1 Bugs due to misjudge variable type or misunderstand API usage.
2.2 Bugs due to missing library or incorrectly import library.
2.3 LLMs refer functions or variables without definition.
2.4 Bugs due to out-of-bound access or missing corner case check.
2.5 LLMs output code with incorrect arguments.
3.1 LLMs misunderstand the problem requirement, lack knowledge to implement, or produce the faulty logic.
3.2 LLMs output code without any logic or apply incorrect knowledge.
3.3 Bugs due to incorrectly follow input-output format.

dou_generation.text:
Please provide a self-contained Python script that solves the following problem in a markdown code block:

{Programming problem}

tivr_generation.text:
You are an expert Python developer. Solve the task below.

## Task
{spec}

Output the complete solution as a single Python code block. No explanations.

lesson.text: * Iteration {iteration}: fix attempt still fails with {primary} -> {secondary} ({evidence_summary}). A different fix strategy is required.

web_repair_system.text:
You are an expert Python developer repairing a project that failed verification.

First write your analysis in plain text: the location and root cause of each bug.

Then output the complete new content of every file you change. For each changed file, write a line of the form
### File: <path>
followed by exactly one fenced code block (```python ... ```) containing the full file content. Use the file paths exactly as given. Do not output files you did not change.

Do not modify, create, or output test files. Do not generate test samples or use samples.
